mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the wet food remainder with microbes was most worthwhile: it showed what bacteria can make from fibre that our enzymes leave behind.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus to the lining was clear but fairly predictable from the picture.

surprise.text: The inner wall recovered water and could use some bacterial products as fuel; I had mainly expected a protective barrier.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures showed where the wall pieces belonged and why the microbes met the fibre.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter because the connection between bacteria, food and the colon wall made me curious about other body relationships, though the fitting steps themselves were predictable.
